description: Use when testing a web application for Cross-Site Request Forgery on an authorized engagement. Covers mapping state-changing requests, detecting missing or weak anti-CSRF tokens, building HTML proof-of-concept exploits, testing SameSite cookie behavior, bypassing Referer and Origin checks, and attacking login CSRF and token-validation flaws. Use when forms, account settings, password changes, or API actions change state without a per-request token, or when you need to prove a forged cross-site request executes as the victim.
